headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a 3-0 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke earning the win after pitching 6.2 innings with 5 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Grant Taylor secured the save in the win.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with Will Vest being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation by the Detroit Tigers. The Washington Nationals placed PJ Poulin on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 16, 2026, due to a left flexor strain, and transferred Richard Lovelady from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left triceps strain.

Several trades and roster movements occurred, with the Chicago Cubs acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash, and the St. Louis Cardinals acquired right-handed pitcher Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Trent Grisham leading the offense. Grisham hit a home run and drove in one run in the game.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 2-1, securing a narrow victory. Tommy Edman led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in Dominant 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Sonny Gray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Willson Contreras led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Vest Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Will Vest has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
